description: Les réseaux de chaleur en Bretagne - État des lieux 2018 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.cdata.cerema.fr. The data made available on this platform are intended to allow the visualization of the results of the 2018 census of heating networks in Brittany. This initiative was commissioned by the Regional Directorate for the Environment, Planning and Housing in the Brittany region. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Heat networks in Brittany - State of play 2018" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Sources d'énergie, Chaleur renouvelable, Réseaux de chaleur. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
